name: @velaros-ai/project
description: The project space for VelarOS hosts: the assembly that mounts velar:project and velar:code (the project tools and kernel from @velaros-ai/velar/project) together with velar:shell, velar:sandbox and velar:images on project ports — commands confined to the project root and its resource gate, sandboxes mirroring only project directories, pictures only from inside the project, and only dangerous commands asking the user — plus the verification policy handed to the agent's coding session.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test
